title: EpiFlowML model input row (long-format CSV)
description: One row of the ingested CSV consumed by MeaslesDataLoader.prepData. GEO_ID and date are required for the loader. depVar and predictors are experiment-specific; additional columns use additionalProperties. Script 7 renames ISO3 to GEO_ID at export; interim ingestion scripts keep ISO3. For column semantics and preprocessor rules see data_ingestion_pipeline/MODEL_INPUT_SCHEMA.md and model/input/PreprocessorConfig.csv.

GEO_ID.description: Geography key for grouping and filters (typically ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, e.g. NGA; may support other stable IDs in future).

date.description: Calendar date for the row; monthly MS alignment recommended. Parsed in Python and renamed to ds.
